name: List and Create Files in Google Drive
description: Search for files in Google Drive or create a new file/folder. Supports Drive search query syntax for filtering.

operation.description: Operation: 'list' to search/list files, 'create' to create a file or folder

query.description: Drive search query for list operation (e.g., "name contains 'report'" or "mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.folder'")

name.description: File or folder name (for create operation)

pageSize.description: Number of files to return (list operation, max 1000)
